collection.title: Renault Master 1997 to 2010 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Renault Master Van 1997 to 2010 will fit, this model requires a 24" wiper blade on both the drivers side with and the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade
